comment: How Copilot CLI runs a seat. The role comes from policy/library.json (lane -> role); each library role runs as the custom agent profile `<profilePrefix><role>` (install them with `npm run harness -- agents install`) unless `agents` maps it to another; generated roles run as `<profilePrefix><fallback.agent>` with their charter in the prompt. A profile that isn't installed is skipped (no --agent) rather than failing the turn. Tool flags come from the seat's catalog permissions through `tools`; a seat without a write permission also gets --deny-tool write. Tool names are placeholders to check against your CLI version. `models` maps the library's model placeholders to model ids your Copilot plan offers; an empty one is left out and Copilot uses its default (then judges share the workers' model). `lanes` applies only when the policy has no team.
